text:
oliver: Heads-up  two guests dropping by unexpectedly around 11:10. Can reception badge them on arrival?
frontdesk-bot: @oliver noted. Please DM full names for pre-printing. Kiosk D is online. :printer: 
oliver: Names are Hannah Li and Omar Ben. No RSVP, just a quick demo walk-through.
people-ops: We'll pre-print temporary badges. Remind guests to show ID. If they need parking, we have one Lot-C pass left.
maria: Please hold the Lot-C pass for me  bringing a vendor around 11:05 who might need it.
frontdesk-bot: Reserved Lot-C pass for @maria.
devon: Quick FYI  a small package labelled "Demo dongles" arrived at 09:08 with carrier ShipQuick, left in Locker 7A. Not signed to anyone. :package:
mailer-bot: Package record: tracking SQ-778899, left at 09:08, Locker 7A, marked fragile. Sticker reads "For: Demo Team".
maria: That might be ours. Please don't open; we'll claim it after the tour.
people-ops: We'll log and hold sealed. If unclaimed by EOD we'll return to sender per policy. Also reminder: visitor wifi cards are in the top drawer by reception.
oliver: Thanks. Also need a small table near 3F for the demo laptop  can facilities drop a folding side table?
people-ops: Facilities pinged. If the table isn't free by 11:00 please move the high-top stool near 3F.
devon: Also note the bench by the pantry is reserved for a team lunch at 12:00  guests should use the lounge bench or high-top.
frontdesk-bot: Badges printed and placed in "Pre-printed" tray. Lot-C pass taped to Maria's badge. Locker 7A logged as "Hold - Demo dongles".
oliver: Perfect. I'll meet them in the lobby at 11:05 and escort up. If anyone needs the HDMI from the dongles, shout now.
maria: I can grab the HDMI if the box is claimed. If not, I'll sign it out on the package log.
devon: I'll wait for you at reception  can someone also leave a note on the whiteboard in 3F: "Demo starting 11:15"?
people-ops: Done  whiteboard note left. Logging this on today's visitor ledger for badge reconciliation. Reminder to hosts: return temporary badges to dropbox when guests leave. :white_check_mark:
